issues.description: SealSaloon: the problem statement gives conflicting guidance about whether the shared stock and two helper methods are class-level (static) or instance-level. The UML fragment (problem_statement.md lines 25-34) shows the SealSaloon members without indicating they are static, while the textual instructions (problem_statement.md lines 77-81) explicitly require the stock attribute and the methods acceptSupplyDelivery and calculateTotalPrice to be static. The reference solution implements these members as static (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java: stock at line 5; acceptSupplyDelivery signature at line 50; calculateTotalPrice signature at line 60). This mismatch between UML and text can confuse students about whether to declare these members static when they implement SealSaloon.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification consistent: either update the UML in problem_statement.md to mark the stock attribute and the methods acceptSupplyDelivery and calculateTotalPrice as static (class-level), or remove the textual requirement that they be static. Also ensure the starter template or an explicit note matches the chosen design so students are not forced to reconcile conflicting representations.
